candidate.selection_reason: URL parameter token ID -> executes backend download operation -> serves files with potential path traversal
candidate.source_summary: URL parameter tokenId from this.params.tokenId, validated by checking FileTokens collection existence
candidate.sink_summary: sandstormBackend.downloadBackup writes file content to HTTP response stream, serving files from /var/sandstorm/backups/
candidate.guard_summary: Token existence check in FileTokens collection; filename sanitization removes quotes and newlines; backend uses direct path concatenation without path traversal validation
candidate.risk_pattern: URL token parameter directly concatenated into file path without path traversal validation, allowing potential directory traversal if tokenId contains '../' sequences
candidate.context_summary: Server route handler for backup downloads that validates token existence but passes tokenId directly to backend without path traversal checks
unresolved_facts: Whether validateId function is called in downloadBackup implementation
Whether raiiOpen function performs path validation
Whether backupId parameter is restricted to safe characters

target_cwe.description: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that should be within a restricted directory, but it does not properly neutralize sequences such as .. that can resolve to a location that is outside of that directory. Common in: path_traversal, input_validation.
target_cwe.impact: code execution, data access, data modification
remediation_steps: Validate and sanitize all file paths and names
Use canonical path resolution and access controls

stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: Direct use of untrusted tokenId in file path construction without sanitization for '../' sequences
